quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A small library began lending portable Wi-Fi devices to families who could not afford home internet service. Students borrowing the devices were able to complete online homework for the first time without going to a coffee shop or staying late at school. Within its first year, the program had a waiting list longer than the number of devices available.
options: A Library That Removed All Internet Access
A Program with No Demand from Families
Students Who Refused to Borrow the Devices
A Library's Wi-Fi Devices Closing a Homework Gap
quests.correctAnswer: A Library's Wi-Fi Devices Closing a Homework Gap
quests.hint: Notice the access problem the library noticed and how the lending program addressed it.
quests.explanation: A specific access barrier is tied to a solution that proved highly popular. The summary should link the lending program to the gap it closed for students, not just describe the devices.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Three days after patients went home, one regional hospital began calling them to check on their recovery and answer lingering questions. Nurses found that many patients had stopped taking medication correctly simply because they misunderstood the instructions. After the calls began, the hospital saw a noticeable drop in patients returning to the emergency room within two weeks of discharge.
options: A Hospital That Stopped Contacting Discharged Patients
Calls That Increased Confusion About Medication
Follow-Up Calls Reducing Early Hospital Readmissions
Readmissions That Rose After the Calls Began
quests.correctAnswer: Follow-Up Calls Reducing Early Hospital Readmissions
quests.hint: Consider what the calls revealed about patients and what effect they had on readmission rates.
quests.explanation: A simple follow-up practice uncovers a hidden problem and reduces a serious outcome here. The summary should connect the calls with the drop in readmissions, not just the phone check-in itself.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A streaming platform noticed that viewers frequently abandoned long documentaries partway through, so it began releasing the same content as shorter, stand-alone episodes instead of single long films. Completion Rates That Dropped with Shorter Episodes
Shorter Episodes Boosting Documentary Completion Rates
Producers Who Refused to Change Their Format

quests.hint: Think about the viewing problem the platform noticed and how changing the format solved it.
quests.explanation: A format change is directly tied to a measurable improvement in how much people watch. The summary should connect the shorter episodes with the rise in completion rates.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A printed notice taped to the apartment mailbox area explained that the building's recycling bins would be moved to a new location starting next week, due to a renovation in the parking garage. Several residents initially complained on the building's group chat, assuming the change was permanent and inconvenient. Once they saw the new location was actually closer to most units, the complaints quickly stopped.

A Misunderstood Notice About Moving Recycling Bins
Residents Who Found the New Location Worse
A Permanent Closure of the Parking Garage

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Tired of forgetting to water her houseplants, Elif set a recurring reminder on her phone for every Sunday morning. At first, the reminder felt like just another chore added to her week. After a few months, however, checking on her plants became something she actually looked forward to, and several previously struggling plants began thriving.
options: Elif Ignoring the Reminder Every Week
Plants That Continued Struggling Despite the Reminder
A Reminder Elif Deleted After One Month
A Weekly Reminder Turning Plant Care into a Hobby

quests.explanation: A shift from obligation to genuine enjoyment is the real story here. The summary should capture that emotional change along with the improved plant health, not just describe the original reminder.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A high school replaced its traditional written final exams in history class with a project where students had to create a short documentary about a historical event of their choice. Some students who normally struggled with timed writing produced detailed, well-researched projects when given more creative freedom. Teachers noted that overall engagement with the material increased significantly compared to previous years.
options: A Documentary Project Boosting Engagement in History Class
A School That Removed All History Assessments
Students Who Performed Worse Without Written Exams
Engagement That Dropped After the Project Was Introduced

quests.explanation: An alternative assessment helps certain students succeed and raises overall engagement. The summary should connect the new project format with that broader improvement, not just describe the assignment.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Several talented junior associates at a mid-sized law firm were leaving within their first two years, often citing a lack of mentorship. In response, the firm paired every new hire with a senior partner for monthly one-on-one career conversations, separate from regular performance reviews. Turnover That Increased After Pairing Employees
A Mentorship Program Cutting Junior Staff Turnover

quests.hint: Identify why junior associates were leaving and what specific program addressed that reason.
quests.explanation: A stated reason for turnover is connected to a targeted solution and its measurable result. The summary should link the mentorship program to the drop in turnover.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A budget airline that previously charged separate fees for nearly every service, including carry-on bags, switched to a single, simpler pricing structure after years of customer complaints about hidden costs. Customer satisfaction scores rose noticeably within the first quarter after the change. options: Simpler Pricing Restoring Customer Trust in an Airline
An Airline That Added Even More Hidden Fees
Satisfaction Scores That Dropped After the Change
Bookings That Decreased Following the New Pricing

quests.hint: Focus on what problem customers had with the old pricing and how the new system addressed it.
quests.explanation: A pricing change is directly tied to improved trust and business results. The summary should connect the simplified fees with both the satisfaction increase and the booking growth.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.

She worried at first about whether she could keep up with different grade levels at once. quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.

options: A Chain That Stopped Selling Discounted Produce
Customers Who Never Returned After Trying It Once

A Discount Produce Section Reducing Grocery Food Waste

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.

A Voicemail That Gave No Useful Details

Mr. Reyes Receiving Conflicting Information from the School

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
